Use case: ui-mockup. Produce one high-resolution raster concept board of SIX redesigned mobile game purchase popups in 3 columns x2 rows. Every card same size and row CTA baselines aligned. Large readable Vietnamese. Pale warm beige canvas. Soft Miniature cute matte 3D miniature style, cream panels, navy typography, orange purchase buttons, purple gems, blue accents. Restrained ornament, no giant decorative ribbons. Input images are ONLY style and content references: DO NOT copy their composition or equal 2x2 tile grids. New layout direction described below is mandatory.
Content order and exact data, top row left to right then bottom:
1 starter_1: "Gói Tân binh". 150 Gem; 3 Vé Pro (red star ticket); 3 Vé Standard (blue/gold gear ticket); 1 giờ Thu nhập (cash clock). Small value label 4,4×. Boy mechanic with brown hair, goggles, blue/yellow suit. Price "$0.99"; "Mua 1 lần" and "Xem tỉ lệ". Note "Tiền tính theo thu nhập của đội tại thời điểm mua."
2 weekly_s: "Gói tuần S". 300 Gem; 6 Vé All-Star (gold star ticket); 4 Vé Elite (purple gear ticket); 4 giờ Thu nhập. Small value label 2,6×. Same boy identity. Price "$4.99"; "1 lần / tuần" and "Xem tỉ lệ". Same income-time note.
3 offer_noads_bundle: "Đội tự do + quà". Bỏ quảng cáo / Vĩnh viễn; 300 Gem; 3 Vé All-Star. Crossed-out ad TV and miniature shield. Price "$9.99"; "Mua 1 lần" and "Xem tỉ lệ". Note "Tắt Ads Break và nhận thẳng thưởng quảng cáo, theo giới hạn từng mục."
4 income_x2: "Thu nhập ×2". Online income ×2 AND race rewards ×2 permanently. Miniature garage with cash. Show "Thu nhập online ×2", "Thưởng đua ×2", "Vĩnh viễn". No gems/tickets included. Price "$4.99"; "Mua 1 lần". Note "Không áp dụng offline. Không cộng dồn boost quảng cáo (lấy mức cao hơn)."
5 no_ads: "Đội tự do". Bỏ quảng cáo / Vĩnh viễn; 100 Gem. Crossed-out ad TV, shield. Price "$9.99"; "Mua 1 lần". Note "Tắt Ads Break và nhận thẳng thưởng quảng cáo, theo giới hạn từng mục."
6 char_my: "My về đội bạn". Guaranteed driver Zielinski with 30 mảnh Zielinski, 100 Gem, 3 Vé Elite. Character is smiling brown-haired female racer, side braid, red cap with checker patch and red/white suit, thumbs up. Show "Zielinski", "Nhận chắc chắn", "30 mảnh", "100 Gem", "3 Vé Elite". Price "$4.99"; "Mua 1 lần" and "Xem tỉ lệ".
All popups red X close at upper right. Preserve quantities, prices, limits and perk semantics. No fictional timers or discounts, no invented gifts, no offline doubling. NO equal 2x2 tile grids. Text clear with correct accents, no code or annotations. Title board only the direction name as small top heading if useful. Canvas square with generous gutters; six full cards visible.

LAYOUT DIRECTION 1 — QUYỀN LỢI CHÍNH + QUÀ KÈM. Radically reduce illustration to a small side cutout taking only 15-20% card area, never a large full-width hero picture. Typography-first composition. Top compact flat navy title and X. Then a HUGE main benefit block taking upper-middle card with an oversized count: starter "150 Gem", weekly "300 Gem"; a small mechanic cutout sits to the side of number. Bundle and noads full-width main entitlement "Bỏ quảng cáo" with "Vĩnh viễn". Income card huge "×2" with "Thu nhập online & thưởng đua" and "Vĩnh viễn". Character main block large name "Zielinski" with "Nhận chắc chắn" next to side portrait. Under main benefit create ONE distinct recessed horizontal/vertical tray labeled "QUÀ KÈM", smaller hierarchy, containing compact icon+label rows of ONLY secondary items (do not repeat primary benefit): starter 3 Vé Pro, 3 Vé Standard, 1 giờ Thu nhập; weekly 6 Vé All-Star, 4 Vé Elite, 4 giờ Thu nhập; bundle 300 Gem and 3 Vé All-Star; no_ads 100 Gem; character 30 mảnh Zielinski, 100 Gem, 3 Vé Elite. Income card uses matching tray labeled "QUYỀN LỢI" listing online ×2 and race ×2, not QUÀ KÈM because no extra gifts. Caveat at bottom then common full-width orange CTA, then purchase-limit footer. Use ample whitespace and strong large-number hierarchy, larger main-benefit typography than any secondary gift. DO NOT make an art/benefit/tile stack like reference.
